[Erowid Note: 
Because opiate use can lead to significant tolerance (requiring higher doses for the same effects), the dose used by a first time user is significantly smaller than that used by a regular user. It can be extremely dangerous to choose ones dose on the basis of the amount taken by someone else. Overdoses of opiates can be fatal.]
Anyway this drug is great because unlike other painkillers I dont need to pop them all day to keep my high. Oxy takes a little bit longer to kick in because of its time release but once it does I'm set for the next 18-24 hours depending on my tolerance. The high is relatively heavy, it makes me really drowsy. My body also felt warm and relaxed, and of course very very euphoric. Another great thing about oxy is that I can eat a 12 course meal and the high wont even begin to descend unless of course the proper amount of time has alloted. That seems to be the only thing that kills it. Yet again its a constant 18-24 hours of pleasure.
The only thing I dont like about this drug is that it has a lot of side-effects to it. My last few experiences with oxycontin has been with 80mg doses taken orally. But when I first started experimenting I didnt have the patience for waiting so I would ingest 40mg of oxycontin it intranasally. What happened around the fourth time of doing that way well, there's a reason for the time release around this tiny little pills. The 'normal' painkillers do not usually have time release mainly I'm guessing because they are not remotely close to being as potent. Well, anyway back to the story the first thing I noticed was not to my liking. See the reaction people are looking for is instant gratification the right away feeling of feeling great, especially when it comes to opiates/opiodes because that's what there job is. What I noticed at first was not that pleasurable and expected affect, my heart sped up from 65 b.p.m to 125 b.p.m. Whatever right? Most 'drug users' dont care because thats what drugs do right? but I dont find any benefit from using any other drugs and the substances I prefer ARE NOT suppose to increase your heart rate. Back to the story clammy hands paranoia yada yada yada. Long story short and consumed to much of the narcotic at once.
Now I just take 80mg orally and I couldnt snort it even if i wanted to because now they cut oxycontin with something that once the pill enters wet nasal passges it turns to a waxy paste impossible of being snorted through your nasal cavity.
Better than heroin because it has the same effects and I know what I'm getting.
